playbook.name: Tasks Due Soon
playbook.description: Notifies the user of open Task-type sprk_event records (sprk_eventtype_ref = Task) due from their local today through today + 3 days on their matters, on matters they own, or that they own. The 3-day window is fixed (the scheduler sets dueSoonWindowUtc; the dueWithinDays parameter is not applied yet). Uses Spaarke custom sprk_event entity (NOT OOB task activity).

nodes.name: Start
nodes.configjson: {"__actionType":33,"scope":"user-matters","resolveUserId":true,"description":"Scoped to the current user's matters (resolved via LookupUserMembership node)"}

nodes.name: Lookup My Matters
nodes.configjson: {"__actionType":52,"entityType":"sprk_matter","targeting":"people","includeRelated":false,"description":"Resolve the matters FOR the executing user via the people-targeting surface (targeting: people, ADR-034 Amendment A3): records they created (human Created By), are named on (Assigned To, via their linked contact) or personally own — never matters reached only through team, business-unit or organization ownership. Bound to `myMatters.ids` for downstream filtering (the query writes them as <value> children with fetchInGuids)."}

nodes.name: Query Tasks Due Soon
nodes.configjson: {"__actionType":51,"queryMode":true,"entityLogicalName":"sprk_event","fetchXml":"<fetch top=\"50\"><entity name=\"sprk_event\"><attribute name=\"sprk_eventname\"/><attribute name=\"sprk_duedate\"/><attribute name=\"sprk_finalduedate\"/><attribute name=\"sprk_eventid\"/><attribute name=\"sprk_eventtype_ref\"/><attribute name=\"statuscode\"/><attribute name=\"modifiedon\"/><attribute name=\"sprk_regardingrecordname\"/><attribute name=\"sprk_regardingrecordurl\"/><attribute name=\"sprk_regardingmatter\"/><attribute name=\"ownerid\"/><link-entity name=\"sprk_matter\" from=\"sprk_matterid\" to=\"sprk_regardingmatter\" link-type=\"outer\" alias=\"m\"><attribute name=\"sprk_mattername\"/><attribute name=\"ownerid\"/></link-entity><filter type=\"and\"><condition attribute=\"sprk_eventtype_ref\" operator=\"eq\" value=\"124f5fc9-98ff-f011-8406-7c1e525abd8b\"/><condition attribute=\"statuscode\" operator=\"eq\" value=\"659490001\"/><filter type=\"and\"><condition attribute=\"sprk_duedate\" operator=\"ge\" value=\"{{todayUtc}}\"/><condition attribute=\"sprk_duedate\" operator=\"le\" value=\"{{dueSoonWindowUtc}}\"/></filter><filter type=\"or\"><condition attribute=\"sprk_regardingmatter\" operator=\"in\">{{fetchInGuids myMatters.ids}}</condition><condition entityname=\"m\" attribute=\"ownerid\" operator=\"eq-userid\"/><condition attribute=\"ownerid\" operator=\"eq-userid\"/></filter></filter><order attribute=\"sprk_duedate\" descending=\"false\"/></entity></fetch>","templateParameters":{"dueWithinDays":"{{userPreferences.dueWithinDays ?? 3}}"},"description":"Open Task-type sprk_event rows (sprk_eventtype_ref = Task 124f5fc9-98ff-f011-8406-7c1e525abd8b, statuscode = Open 659490001) with sprk_duedate from the user's local today (todayUtc, set per user by the scheduler) through today + 3 days (dueSoonWindowUtc, set by the scheduler), where (a) sprk_regardingmatter is one of the user's matters (myMatters.ids from Lookup My Matters, written as <value> children by fetchInGuids; an empty list matches nothing), OR (b) the linked matter's owner is the user, OR (c) the task's own owner is the user. sprk_finalduedate is read for display only (D-63). Ordered by sprk_duedate ascending (D-73); at most 50."}

nodes.name: Check Results
nodes.configjson: {"__actionType":30,"condition":{"operator":"gt","left":"{{dueSoonQuery.output.count}}","right":0},"trueBranch":"Create Notification","description":"Check if any tasks are due within the configured window"}

nodes.name: Create Notification
nodes.configjson: {"__actionType":50,"title":"{{dueSoonQuery.output.count}} task(s) due in the next {{dueWithinDays}} day(s)","body":"{{#each dueSoonQuery.output.items}}{{sprk_eventname}} is due on {{sprk_duedate}}.\n{{/each}}","category":"tasks-due-soon","priority":200000000,"actionUrl":"/main.aspx?pagetype=entitylist&etn=sprk_event&viewtype=1039","recipientId":"{{run.userId}}","regardingType":"sprk_event","iterateItems":true,"itemNotification":{"title":"Due soon: {{item.sprk_eventname}}","body":"{{item.sprk_eventname}} is due on {{item.sprk_duedate}} ({{item.sprk_regardingrecordname}})","category":"tasks-due-soon","priority":200000000,"actionUrl":"/main.aspx?pagetype=entityrecord&etn=sprk_event&id={{item.sprk_eventid}}","recipientId":"{{run.userId}}","regardingId":"{{item.sprk_eventid}}","regardingType":"sprk_event","dueDate":"{{item.sprk_duedate}}","regardingName":"{{item.sprk_eventname}}","sourceEntityType":"sprk_event","sourceId":"{{item.sprk_eventid}}","sourceModifiedOn":"{{item.modifiedon}}","sourceOwningUser":"{{item.ownerid}}","viaMatterId":"{{item.sprk_regardingmatter}}","viaMatterName":"{{lookup item 'm.sprk_mattername'}}","viaMatterMembershipsVariable":"myMatters"},"deduplication":{"enabled":true,"key":"tasks-due:{{run.userId}}:{{item.sprk_eventid}}"}}
